assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / game asset. Create ONE premium football shirt source sprite for a mobile game. Delivery square1024x1024 PNG with genuine TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Center entire garment with approximately8percent clear margin on every side, fully visible sleeves and hem. Perfectly front-facing orthographic camera, no rotation, exact bilateral symmetry in garment silhouette, floating empty shirt, no person, no mannequin, no hanger, no body or arms, no rear view. Slight realistic3D volume, refined modern lightweight performance fabric, CLEAN PURE WHITE base fabric, delicate fine knit weave, realistic soft folds and controlled pale-gray occlusion in folds, soft white satin highlights with gentle upper-left studio light. Maintain mostly WHITE broad body and sleeve areas so artwork can be recolored in code. No gray shirt, no yellow cast, no dramatic black body shadows. Silhouette clean and easy to mask. The collar band and BOTH sleeve cuffs must be uniformly SOLID PURE BLACK#000000 with crisp boundaries, no gray sheen in these black trim regions. These black parts will be segmented by software and recolored. Keep collar and cuff construction simple, clearly separated from white body. No other black panels, no side stripes, no piping, no decorative stitching, no text, no number, no logo, no crest, no sponsor, no pattern. No external drop shadow or background plane; shading is confined to the garment. Render like a high-quality football kit catalog cutout, realistic but restrained, readable as a small game sprite.
Specific garment: Short-sleeved football shirt with a ROUND CREW NECK. The round collar ring is solid black. Both short sleeve cuffs have a simple solid black narrow band, equal width. White chest and sleeves, symmetric sleeves relaxed slightly outward. Refined softly squared hem.
assets.edit_prompt:
Precise technical asset cleanup of this exact shirt cutout. Preserve exact garment, neck style, sleeve length, folds, white fabric lighting and material. Preserve genuine transparent background.

1. Collar and both cuffs (also polo placket if present) are technical segmentation regions. Replace ALL their dark-gray shading and fabric texture with UNIFORM SOLID pure BLACK RGB(0,0,0), hexadecimal#000000. Absolutely no highlights, gray ribbing or reflected light on black trim. Keep the crisp existing trim outline. White body shading remains realistic and unchanged. Polo two buttons may have subtle thin gray circular outlines for visibility, but placket base black.
